scripts.// build: tsc runs first on purpose: Vite strips types without checking them, so without this a type error builds clean and ships. This is what makes Vercel fail the deploy instead. The three steps after vite build prerender every route to static HTML -- see scripts/prerender.mjs.
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist/server && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/cleanup-ssr.mjs
